global_rules: Keep both source populations and epochs distinct.
No row-level joint microdata, invented personas, identity conclusions, causality or matched individuals.
No Sankey/flow diagram from separate marginals.
Always show source link, observation dates, denominator, unit and multiple-response status.
This package does not supply current 2026 rates.

contracts.claim: 316 of 600 respondents reported northbound consumption at least monthly; 170 less often; 114 none.
contracts.required_label: November 2024 interview sample of 600 Hong Kong residents aged 18–74; transport-node intercepts. Descriptive sample percentages only. Preceding-year recall. Detailed monthly percentage source typo corrected from count.
n=486 respondents reporting northbound consumption; multiple responses; shares need not sum to 100%.

contracts.claim: 181 of 600 respondents reported Mainland medical services; 419 did not.
contracts.required_label: November 2024 interview sample of 600 Hong Kong residents aged 18–74; transport-node intercepts. Descriptive sample percentages only.
forbidden: Merge V12 medical main activity (74) with V13 any medical service (181)

contracts.claim: Reported medical use differs within sampled age groups.
contracts.evidence_filter: table=5.9; show Yes only if charting use
contracts.allowed_visual: Age-group bars using each row denominator
contracts.required_label: Within-age sample proportions; show group n; 75+ excluded.

contracts.claim: Medical-service destinations and service types are separately reported marginals.
contracts.allowed_visual: Separate bars or destination dots without flow widths
contracts.required_label: n=181 medical-service users; multiple responses; destination is medical-specific.

contracts.claim: Reported motivations and barriers differ between medical users and non-users.
contracts.required_label: Users n=181; non-users n=419; up to three selections each.

contracts.claim: Seven new pilot providers recorded 15,468 claims totaling HK$19.782 million in rounded reported amounts.
contracts.allowed_visual: Separate transaction and claimed-amount bars; total cards
contracts.required_label: Provider inception through 31 December 2024; unequal operating windows; excludes two existing HKU–SZH service points.

contracts.claim: C.K.J accounted for 57.6% of these claims and 77.2% of the rounded claimed amount.
contracts.evidence_filter: institution=Shenzhen C.K.J Stomatological Hospital; totals over seven rows
contracts.required_label: Descriptive concentration among seven newly added pilot providers through 2024-12-31; unequal start dates.
forbidden: Market share of all cross-border care

contracts.claim: 1,681 reported users usually resided in Mainland GBA cities, including 130 in Shenzhen.
contracts.allowed_visual: Counts preferred; explicitly denominated percentages optional
contracts.required_label: 9,064 reported users overall; 1,681 GBA usual residents. Deduplication method unspecified. Source percentage header ambiguous.
forbidden: Remaining users all Hong Kong residents

contracts.claim: Calendar-year 2025 pilot claims totaled 51,384 and a published HK$51.811 million across 19 providers.
contracts.allowed_visual: Separate annual transaction and claimed-amount bars; dated total cards
contracts.required_label: Calendar 2025; 19 providers including 12 midyear entrants. Unequal exposure. Rounded provider amounts sum HK$51.812m versus published total HK$51.811m.

contracts.claim: C.K.J accounted for 44.5% of 2025 pilot claims and 70.5% of published claimed value.
contracts.allowed_visual: Separate labeled share bars or year selector with changing scope explicit
contracts.required_label: 2025 annual; claims denominator 51,384 and amount denominator HK$51.811m. 19 providers, staggered starts.
forbidden: Causal explanation for share decline from 2024

contracts.claim: Six complaints were received by end-2025; four investigations found no agreement noncompliance or aberrant claims and two were open as at 28 February 2026.
contracts.allowed_visual: Dated text note or 4/2 status count card
contracts.required_label: Cumulative complaints through end-2025; status as at 2026-02-28.
forbidden: Complaint prevalence or provider quality rate
